Today's AI briefing from The Gradient | 2026-10-28

1. Retell uses OpenAI models to help power 100M monthly calls
Retell integrated OpenAI’s GPT‑6 Astra for its voice‑agent benchmark and Codex for code generation, enabling the platform to support 100 M monthly calls.

2. Greptile takes bug detection beyond code review with GPT-6 Astra
Greptile integrated OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra to automatically test real user workflows, paired it with Daybreak for security hardening, and used Codex to cut down on repetitive rework.

3. GPT-6.1 Sol helps CodeRabbit strengthen security across complex codebases
CodeRabbit integrated GPT-6.1 Sol as a security agent to automatically investigate and flag vulnerabilities across complex, large‑scale code repositories. The model not only identifies risks but also proposes concrete remediation steps for developers to review.
